plan.goal: Собеседование в пятницу, боюсь вопросов про опыт

findings.detail: scene 2: must_say 1 «describe what you did in your previous job» starts with no verb of the list

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The interview has just started in an office or meeting room. The learner is meeting the interviewer for a job interview on Friday and needs to handle the opening calmly before deeper questions begin. This scene covers the basic start and the first simple exchange about the role.
Learner: Job candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: describing responsibilities in past jobs in detail, talking about skills and strengths, discussing salary or next steps.

must_say.text: say which position you are applying for
say how long you worked there
ask what the main duties are
ask what the work schedule is

must_understand.text: asks your name and which position you want
asks where you worked before and for how long
says the main duties of the job

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The interviewer moves to the main part of the conversation and asks about the learner's background. The learner's main worry is questions about experience, so this is the core scene where misunderstanding matters most. It focuses on simple, concrete ways to talk about past work and understand what experience the employer needs.
Learner: Job candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: introductions, stating your name, asking about the schedule, salary negotiation or signing documents.

must_say.text: describe what you did in your previous job
say what tools or programs you used
say what you can do well
answer whether you have done a task before
ask whether experience in a field is required
ask what happens next in the hiring process

must_understand.text: asks what your previous duties were
asks which tools or programs you used
asks whether you have done a similar task before
says which experience or skills matter most
explains the next step after the interview
